# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please do not report security vulnerabilities or personal data exposure in public GitHub issues.

Use GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting for this repository when available, or contact the repository owner directly through GitHub. Include the affected path, impact, and minimal reproduction details.

## Secret and Privacy Hygiene

Never commit API keys, tokens, `.env` files, private certificates, local database files, customer material, or personal contact identifiers. Use `.env.example` with placeholder values for configuration documentation.
